title: Process-local UTF-8 for Unicode Method Flow output
failure_signature: The Method Flow summary print could not encode valid Māori text through a legacy Windows console code page.
candidate_workaround: Set UTF-8 output encoding for the single runner process, rerun summarize, and parse the emitted JSON receipt.
recurrence_guard: Use process-local UTF-8 when Unicode may reach stdout; never replace or anglicize Māori wording to satisfy a console codec.
rollback: Retain the failed print, leave host settings unchanged, and rerun only the bounded command with UTF-8 output.
scope_boundary: Console transport only; it does not confer cultural authority or validate substantive wording.
